Overview

The Sorcerer is a ranged glass cannon that casts both fire and ice. Fire does the damage — Fire Mark marks the target and Blaze cashes it in — while ice slows, roots and freezes so nothing reaches you. Half of your damage bonuses depend on mana: above 50% MP you crit more, above 25% you deal 20% more damage.

The build in one sentence

Open with Element Enhancement, Delayed Explosion and Winter's Shackles, then charge Hellfire fully by hand inside the 5 seconds of Winter's Shackles; the rest runs on stacked hotbar lines, and Wish of Concentration goes last.

  • Play in target mode. With a locked target the basic attack Flame Arrow keeps firing by itself after every skill and restores MP. In action mode it stops after each skill and you have to click again.
  • Two stages. In the first days at 45 your skills sit at 8–10 with one specialization each — take the mana and speed picks named in the cards. The card levels and the highlighted picks are the later target (16, from the global builds and Korean guides); what to take at 12–15 is in each card's text (EUTOPIA).

The skill priority, the specializations up to 15, the hotbar and the macro follow EUTOPIA's global build (October 3) and its update (October 7, level 45, item level 1,730), with damage tests on a training dummy — his skills sit at 14–15 there. The level-16 picks follow the global builds on questlog.gg and the Korean guides. The first-days picks follow aLuckyRO's beginner guide (September 15, Taiwan client) and his global update of October 2. Skill names and data are from the global client.

Patch Season 1. The build is checked against guides from the global servers: 4 stigmas, cap 20.

Passives

PassiveWhy
Robe of FlameAccuracy, PvE Damage Boost and Double Chance — the first passive to max.
Fire MarkApplies Fire Mark, which Blaze needs, and burns the target. Max it.
Robe of EarthMax MP and Critical Hit while MP is 50% or more. Max it.
Grace of Enhancement+20% PvE Damage Boost while MP is 25% or more, and extra hits.
Vitality EvaporationExtra damage while the target is above 70% HP — strong early, when fights are short.
Robe of ColdDefense, Critical Hit Resist and a slow on attackers — EUTOPIA keeps it high for the hard bosses.
Cold SnapExtra damage on slowed targets (Winter's Shackles slows them). Less than it looks — EUTOPIA leaves it low.

Robe of Earth's Critical Hit needs 50% MP or more, Grace of Enhancement's damage boost 25% or more — keep MP above half.

Gear & stats

  • Manastones: Attack, Critical Hit, Accuracy.
  • Watch Max MP and MP regen until your rotation stops running dry.

Daevanion boards

Daevanion takes your skills from 10 to 14 and adds stats. Each blue node gives +1 level to its skill.

  • Priority: orange Combat Speed and Cooldown Reduction, then Attack and Damage Boost, then Critical Damage Boost; after that the blue nodes of Hellfire, Firestorm, Bittercold Wind, Blaze, Wish of Concentration, Winter's Shackles, Flame Arrow and the green Robe of Earth — EUTOPIA picks up every node of these skills; skip Flame Scattershot.
  • Skip Multi-Hit and the defensive orange nodes — a Sorcerer wants flat damage; pick up Accuracy later.
  • Priority: blue nodes for Frost, Winter's Shackles, Firestorm.
  • No Ariel on global: there are five boards, and the level-45 one, Azphel, gives only PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance — in PvE finish the first four.
  • Azphel (level 45) is all PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance — take it.

Macro & rotation

?The macro key is not bound by default: bind it in Settings → Key Settings → General → Macro. Bind it to RMB — then you hold it together with the basic attack on LMB.

AION 2 has two separate tools:

  • Hotbar line — several skills stacked on one hotbar button. Pressing it casts the highest-priority skill that's ready, and in AION 2 the bottom slot has the highest priority. The cards show each line top to bottom as in the game.
  • In-game macro — while you hold its key, it presses your hotbar buttons in order and cancels animation tails. Skills on cooldown are skipped.

EUTOPIA plays on stacked lines and presses them himself. In his test on the same character that gave the most damage: about 21,100 DPS, against 19,200 with his macro and 17,400 with one macro for the whole rotation.

1. Hotbar lines

RMBCore line

  2. 3 Firestorm
  3. 2 Blaze
  4. 1 Bittercold Wind

In-game order, top to bottom. 1 = highest priority — the bottom slot.

Your main button: the root field first, then Blaze and Firestorm; Wish of Concentration only when the rest is on cooldown.

SideSetup line

In-game order, top to bottom. 1 = highest priority — the bottom slot.

Together with Element Enhancement on 2 it opens every burst window.

In-game order, top to bottom. 1 = highest priority — the bottom slot.

Both fields under the target after Hellfire.

Hellfire sits alone on Q, Flame Arrow on LMB, Flame Scattershot on E for staggered bosses.

2. The rotation

  1. Element Enhancement — always the first cast.
  2. Delayed Explosion, then Winter's Shackles: +20% PvE Damage Boost for 5 seconds.
  3. Hellfire charged to 3/3 inside those 5 seconds.
  4. Fire Wall + Cold Storm.
  5. The core line: Bittercold Wind, Blaze, Firestorm, and Wish of Concentration last — at 12–15, before its cooldown cut, it can go first.
  6. Flame Arrow whenever everything is on cooldown.

3. In-game macro — the easy option

If you'd rather hold one key: Settings → Key settings → General → Macro, every step 10 ms. In EUTOPIA's test it does about 10% less damage than the stacked lines.

  1. 1Element Enhancement10 ms
  2. 2Delayed Explosion10 ms
  3. 3Winter's Shackles10 ms
  4. 4Fire Wall10 ms
  5. 5Cold Storm10 ms
  6. 6Bittercold Wind10 ms
  7. 7Firestorm10 ms
  8. 8Flame Arrow10 ms
  • Never put Hellfire in the macro. It is a charge skill: from the macro it fires uncharged, and in EUTOPIA's two-minute test the damage drops by 20–30%. Let go of the macro after Winter's Shackles, hold Hellfire to 3/3, then go back.
  • Blaze and Flame Scattershot stay out of EUTOPIA's macro: each waits for a condition — a Fire Mark on the target, a staggered boss — so he keeps Blaze on the core line and Flame Scattershot on its own key.
  • Wish of Concentration by hand, at the end. It can go in as a ninth step before Flame Arrow, but then you don't control when its cooldown cut lands.
  • Delay: 10 ms with a ping under 50; 40–50 ms with a ping of 80–100 and more. Afterimages ("shadows") behind your character while the macro runs mean the animations are being cancelled.

The hotbar, the macro and the test numbers are read from EUTOPIA's update video (October 7, global). His setup lines sit on side mouse buttons — the lines and the order inside them matter, not the keys.

4. What you actually press

  • OpenElement Enhancement → the setup line → Hellfire charged fully.
  • HoldThe core line, and the field line whenever it is ready.
  • LastWish of Concentration, once the big skills are on cooldown.
  • Low manaA few Flame Arrows — keep MP above 50% so both mana passives stay on.

Recap

  • First days: skills at 8–10 with the mana and speed picks; target mode.
  • Rotation: Element Enhancement → Delayed Explosion → Winter's Shackles → full Hellfire by hand → the fields → Bittercold Wind, Blaze, Firestorm, Wish last.
  • Later: Hellfire, Firestorm, Bittercold Wind, Blaze, Wish of Concentration, Winter's Shackles, Flame Arrow 16; Ice Chain 12 or off the bar.
  • Stigmas: Element Enhancement 20, Delayed Explosion 10, Fire Wall 10, Cold Storm 10 — in this order.
  • Mana: keep it above 50% — that is damage, not comfort.

How to fight while leveling

  • Packs: Bittercold Wind (root) → Hellfire → Ice Chain until they drop.
  • Elites: any fire hit leaves a Fire Mark → Blaze → Firestorm, kiting with Ice Chain slows.
  • Mana: use target mode so the basic attack keeps running, and weave Flame Arrow.
  • Low HP: Steel Barrier and distance — the Sorcerer has no heal.
